summary.prose: One versioned Insors-branded theme policy module drives both artifact shells under unclaimed shared DOM classes (.insrc-viewer page root, .insrc-viewer-diagram diagram wrapper in both shells), so the shared override CSS — including the ER relationship-label dark-on-Crayola fix — applies identically in both paths.
